Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the cost of a catch record card.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to catch record cards; and amending RCW 77.32.430and 77.32.256.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.32.430 and 1998 c 191 s 5 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Catch record cards necessary for proper management of the state'sfood fish and game fish species and shellfish resources shall beadministered under rules adopted by the commission and issued at nocharge for the initial catch record card and ten dollars for eachsubsequent catch record card. A duplicate catch record costs tendollars. The funds received from the sale of catch record cards mustbe deposited into the wildlife fund.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.32.256 and 2002 c 222 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The director shall by rule establish the conditions and fees forissuance of duplicate licenses, rebates, permits, tags, and stampsrequired by this chapter. The fee for duplicate licenses, rebates, p. 1 SB 5207permits, tags, and stamps, except catch record cards, may not exceedthe actual cost to the department for issuing the duplicate.
